summary: Solo hiker (Midwest visitor, first time on the mountain) turned around at 13,600 ft in 65-mph gusts and -33F wind chill, lost the trail in blowing snow at treeline on the Quandary Peak descent, and activated his PLB after dark; survived the night in a bivy sac under a pine. SCRG responded to a USAF/AFRCC PLB call with scattered pings, located him by snowmobile ~1 a.m. Jan 17 in a tree well, hypothermic with frostnip; rewarmed ~1 hour in an ambulance and released to drive to a hotel.
location: Quandary Peak, tree well NE of trail at treeline
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group; U.S. Air Force (AFRCC); Summit County Sheriff's Office; Summit County Ambulance Service
notes: ACR survivor-story page (opened) carries the hiker's first-person account plus SCRG's Jan-17-2016 mission description; incident date 2016-01-16 (Saturday; PLB activation late afternoon, rescue concluded ~1 a.m. Jan 17). PARKED LEAD: the hiker says SCRG told him he was their second Quandary rescue that day — that second 2016-01-16 SCRG Quandary mission is unidentified; do NOT insert a second row until dated and specific.
